title: panicum crus-galli var. minus
intro: Panicum crus-galli var. minus, commonly known as Red Millet, is a plant species in the grass family Poaceae. This herb has been traditionally used in Eastern medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of Red Millet include soothing the respiratory system, reducing fever, and alleviating digestive discomfort, primarily attributed to its calming and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Red Millet include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
